Summary: The command: Offer only unblemished animals (Leviticus 22:21). Every offering brought to the altar was to be perfect, without blemish, that it might be accepted.
Commandment: Offer only unblemished animals, as prescribed in Leviticus 22:21.
Application: It cannot be practised as written without the standing temple and Aaronic priesthood; its enduring lesson is God's holiness, the cost of atonement, and worship offered exactly as God appoints.
Purpose: Scripture's stated ground: it shall be perfect to be accepted (Leviticus 22:21).
